decision.rationale: I recommend approving a provisional credit of 4.26 EUR. TXN-007895 is on card CRD-000084 and was posted on 2026-09-30. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 25 days later, which is inside the 120-day limit. The posted amount is 37.10 EUR (3710 cents). The authorisation AUTH-008104 was for 32.84 EUR (3284 cents): chip payment, PIN verified, approved. The merchant's own receipt DOC-000016 also shows a total of 32.84 EUR. The posted amount is higher than both the authorised amount and the receipt, so the difference of 3710 − 3284 = 426 cents (4.26 EUR) was charged without agreement. Under amount-above-receipt, only this difference is credited, not the whole transaction. It equals the amount the cardholder claimed and is well under the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated provisional credit. Neither the documents nor the records contained any instructions.
